# LinguaLift

> > LinguaLift is a language learning platform offering personalized tutoring and committed to global education access through partnerships with UNESCO.

LinguaLift provides language instruction in Japanese, Russian, Hebrew, French, and other languages through expert tutors like Miho Araki, Stanislav Semerikov, Alisa Zingerman, and Jamie Brigg. The platform combines personalized learning with social impact initiatives focused on education access in developing countries.
